standard_prerequisites.name: Extending a rational map after a modification
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, the lemma producing a proper modification over which a rational map into a proper target is defined
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the proper morphism to the source which is an isomorphism over the domain of the rational map and carries a morphism agreeing with it.

standard_prerequisites.name: Dominating a proper modification by normalized blowups
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma dominating a proper modification of a Nagata surface by a sequence of normalized blowups in closed points
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the modification into a normalization followed by a sequence of normalized blowups and provides the morphism to the target.

core_obligations: Modify the source (proof lines 1397-1405): the extension lemma gives a proper morphism to the source which is an isomorphism over the domain of the rational map together with a morphism to the target agreeing with the rational map there.

Factor through normalized blowups (proof lines 1405-1411): the domination lemma applied to that proper morphism gives a normalization followed by a sequence of normalized blowups in closed points dominating it; composing with the morphism to the target produces the required extension.
proof_roadmap: Produce a proper modification over which the rational map is defined.
Dominate it by a normalization followed by normalized blowups.
Compose to obtain the extension of the rational map.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a rational map from a Noetherian Nagata surface over a base into a proper scheme over that base becomes a morphism after normalizing and performing a sequence of normalized blowups in closed points (statement lines 1389-1402). The proof (proof lines 1403-1411) produces a proper modification and dominates it by normalized blowups. H2: a complete two step reduction.
